chunks: From him, from Ṣafwān, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked one of the two of them, peace be upon them, about a man who performed tawaf around the House and became exhausted: may he delay the tawaf between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah? He said: Yes.

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Ṣafā, one of the two stations of saʿy
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other station of saʿy
key_terms.طَافَ: performed tawaf, meaning circumambulated the Kaʿbah

ai.seo_question: Can someone delay the saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah after tawaf if he becomes tired?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the rites of hajj or ʿumrah. It indicates that if a person completes tawaf of the Kaʿbah and becomes exhausted, he may delay the saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah until a later time.
